text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(turnover) AS ast_to_turnover_ratio, SUM(ast) AS total_assists, SUM(turnover) AS total_turnovers, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE played = 1 AND game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND SUM(turnover) > 0 ORDER BY ast_to_turnover_ratio DESC LIMIT 1
